About NOHS

NOHS is the student community of Negros Occidental High School in Bacolod City, serving learners since 1902 with a culture of excellence and Tatak Probinsyal pride. We bring learners together through teamwork, service, and shared experiences, so every member has a role, a voice, and room to grow.

  • Purpose: Build a united, supportive community inside and beyond the classroom.
  • Values: Neat, Obedient, Honest, and Self Discipline, plus unity, respect, integrity, leadership, and excellence.
  • Goals: Grow member skills, serve the community, and celebrate achievements together.
  • What sets us apart: Every member contributes, and every contribution counts.
